selectAccountText.title: Select Account
selectAccountText.descriptionLinkingProcess: Select your account to link with your external user.
selectAccountText.userMustBeMemberOfOrg: The user must be a member of the {{.OrgName}} organization.

loginText.title: Sign in to Kala
loginText.description: Continue to your private agent workspace.
loginText.descriptionLinkingProcess: Enter your login details to link your external user.
loginText.userMustBeMemberOfOrg: The user must be a member of the {{.OrgName}} organization.

passwordText.title: Welcome back
passwordText.description: Enter your password to continue to Kala.

initPasswordText.title: Set Password
initPasswordText.description: You have received a code, which you have to enter in the form below, to set your new password.

emailVerificationText.title: E-Mail Verification
emailVerificationText.description: We have sent you an email to verify your address. Please enter the code in the form below.

emailVerificationDoneText.title: E-Mail Verification
emailVerificationDoneText.description: Your email address has been successfully verified.

initializeUserText.title: Activate User
initializeUserText.description: Verify your e-mail with the code below and set your password.

initializeDoneText.title: User Activated
initializeDoneText.description: Email verified and Password successfully set

initMfaPromptText.title: 2-Factor Setup
initMfaPromptText.description: 2-factor authentication gives you an additional security for your user account. This ensures that only you have access to your account.
initMfaPromptText.u2fOption: Device dependent (e.g FaceID, Windows Hello, Fingerprint)

initMfaOtpText.title: 2-Factor Verification
initMfaOtpText.description: Create your 2-factor. Download an authenticator app if you do not already have one.
initMfaOtpText.descriptionOtp: Scan the code with your authenticator app (e.g Google/Microsoft Authenticator, Authy) or copy the secret and insert the generated code below.

initMfaU2fText.title: Add Security Key
initMfaU2fText.description: A security key is a verification method that can be built into your phone, use Bluetooth, or plug directly into your computer's USB port.
initMfaU2fText.tokenNameLabel: Name of the security key / device
initMfaU2fText.notSupported: WebAuthN is not supported by your browser. Please ensure it is up to date or use a different one (e.g. Chrome, Safari, Firefox)
initMfaU2fText.errorRetry: Retry, create a new challenge or choose a different method.

initMfaDoneText.title: 2-factor Verified
initMfaDoneText.description: Awesome! You just successfully set up your 2-factor and made your account way more secure. The Factor has to be entered on each login.

mfaProvidersText.u2f: Device dependent (e.g FaceID, Windows Hello, Fingerprint)

verifyMfaU2fText.title: 2-Factor Verification
verifyMfaU2fText.description: Verify your 2-Factor with the registered device (e.g FaceID, Windows Hello, Fingerprint)
verifyMfaU2fText.notSupported: WebAuthN is not supported by your browser. Make sure you are using the newest version or change your browser to a supported one (Chrome, Safari, Firefox)
verifyMfaU2fText.errorRetry: Retry, create a new request or choose a other method.

passwordlessText.title: Login Passwordless
passwordlessText.description: Login with authentication methods provided by your device like FaceID, Windows Hello or Fingerprint.
passwordlessText.notSupported: WebAuthN is not supported by your browser. Please ensure it is up to date or use a different one (e.g. Chrome, Safari, Firefox)
passwordlessText.errorRetry: Retry, create a new challenge or choose a different method.

passwordChangeText.title: Change Password
passwordChangeText.description: Change your password. Enter your old and new password.
passwordChangeText.expiredDescription: You password has expired and has to be changed. Enter your old and new password.

passwordResetDoneText.title: Password Reset Link Sent
passwordResetDoneText.description: Check your email to reset your password.

registrationOptionText.title: Create your Kala account
registrationOptionText.description: Choose how you want to create your private agent workspace.
registrationOptionText.externalLoginDescription: or register with an external user

registrationUserText.title: Create your account
registrationUserText.description: Set up your private Kala workspace.

registrationOrgText.title: Organization Registration
registrationOrgText.description: Enter your organization name and userdata.

externalUserNotFoundText.title: External User Not Found
externalUserNotFoundText.description: External user not found. Do you want to link your user or auto-register a new one?

successLoginText.title: Welcome to Kala
successLoginText.redirectedDescription: You may now close this window.

passwordlessPromptText.title: Passwordless Setup
passwordlessPromptText.description: Would you like to setup passwordless login? (Authentication methods of your device like FaceID, Windows Hello or Fingerprint)
passwordlessPromptText.descriptionInit: You need to set up passwordless login. Use the link you were given to register your device.

passwordlessRegistrationText.title: Passwordless Setup
passwordlessRegistrationText.description: Add your authentication by providing a name (e.g MyMobilePhone, MacBook, etc) and then clicking on the 'Register passwordless' button below.
passwordlessRegistrationText.notSupported: WebAuthN is not supported by your browser. Please ensure it is up to date or use a different one (e.g. Chrome, Safari, Firefox)
passwordlessRegistrationText.errorRetry: Retry, create a new challenge or choose a different method.

passwordlessRegistrationDoneText.title: Passwordless Set Up
passwordlessRegistrationDoneText.descriptionClose: You may now close this window.

externalRegistrationUserOverviewText.title: External User Registration
externalRegistrationUserOverviewText.description: We have taken your user details from the selected provider. You may now change or complete them.
